observed_facts.fact: On 2026-10-07 Taiwan Investigation Bureau searched the Xinzhuang facility and questioned specific employees, according to both companies' material disclosures as reported by the original article.
The inquiry concerns matters during subsidiary Fushida's 2023 application for listing; neither the search nor questioning establishes wrongdoing.
Both issuers said the inquiry had no effect on their operations; this is their assessment, not independent proof of absence of impact.
